lakeview.note: Standing on the Stan Sayres pit apron looking north-west across Lake Washington. The establishing shot: race course, log boom, downtown skyline, Space Needle.

racecourse.note: Over the water looking down the hydroplane race course. Judges hydroplanes, roostertails, wakes, course buoys.

logboom.note: Alongside the log boom. Judges the raft of spectator boats, the logs themselves, people, and how boats sit in the swell.

blueangels.note: Looking up as the Blue Angels come over. Judges the aircraft, the diamond formation, smoke trails and vapour.

pits.note: Inside the Stan Sayres pits. Judges tents, cranes, trailers, crowd, banners — the Seafair festival dressing.

needle.note: Hero shot of the Space Needle and the alien structure grafted onto it.

waterline.note: Eye-level at the waterline. Judges water shading, wave silhouette, foam, sun glitter.

skyline.note: Looking back at the bluff and the city plateau. Judges terrain, vegetation, city massing.

sunward.note: Into the sun over the water. Judges sky scattering, bloom, sun glitter, lens response.

mobile.note: Phone landscape at low quality. Must still read as a beautiful game.
